prompt:
Create ONE production sprite sheet of unique boss Girtas: SIX truly articulated ATTACK poses. Image1 exact original portrait is PRIMARY IDENTITY AUTHORITY; image2 is faithful structural identity enlargement. Use ONLY these two references, no other old model. Preserve original PALE VISIBLE FACE when viewpoint permits, long PALE silver hair, black-and-gold armor, thin hard GOLD RADIAL SPIKES behind upper torso, long DARK GOLD-TRIMMED SKIRT/coat falling below knees, and ONE original LONG SINUOUS orange-gold weapon held in original ANATOMICAL RIGHT HAND. No redV mask, closed faceplate, orange flame/feather fan, broad wings, segmented pants replacing skirt, short broad blade, shield, spear or new gear. Same original proportions and silhouette. Spikes are attached thin solid gold rays, not energy aura; dark long skirt remains in all poses, including loaded knees. Boots can show below hem but never remove the skirt.

DIRECTION: SOUTHWEST, screen LOWER-LEFT toward camera, TRUE FRONT-LEFT three-quarter. ALL6 show visible pale face, front gold chest armor and front long SKIRT, aimed diagonally DOWN-LEFT. Helmet/nose, torso, pelvis, knees/toes all maintain LOWER-LEFT heading. No rear NW view, frontal-flat S switch or lateral W snap. Original anatomical RIGHT weapon arm is same arm as original portrait viewer-left front arm; rotate whole body rather than mirror. Phase3 extends actual right shoulder/elbow and full long weapon DOWN-LEFT toward foreground, not simply W/left sideways. The WHOLE body keeps this exact absolute compass direction in ALL SIX phases, including preparation, contact, follow-through and recovery. Camera remains fixed elevated orthographic isometric. Do not rotate to another direction to reveal a face or show a convenient arm. Keep full connected anatomy: two arms/two hands/two legs, single unchanged weapon in same anatomical RIGHT hand, original rays and hair.

ACTUAL6-PHASE ATTACK read left-to-right/top-to-bottom. Frame0 same-heading guarded stance, full long weapon held safely at original right side. Frame1 anticipation: original right weapon arm raises/retracts blade, knees/hips compress, free left hand balances, exact heading unchanged. Frame2 stronger loaded coil: genuinely bend shoulder/elbow/wrist and shift weight over support, long blade ready to strike in specified direction, no body-facing change. Frame3 CONTACT: actual original right SHOULDER/ELBOW extend into the direction specified above, right hand moves visibly forward relative to chest, and entire long sinuous weapon reaches toward the target in that exact heading. Real connected joint articulation, never just tracing previous blade or snapping whole body to face a different direction. Frame4 follow-through decelerates in SAME heading with hips/knees and long skirt absorbing motion, no reversal. Frame5 recovery returns to guarded stance in SAME heading with hair/skirt settling. Six clearly different full-body arm/hip/knee/silhouette states, anticipation-contact-recovery evident. Do not deliver6idle variants or identical translated poses.

ATLAS exact1024x1536 PNG, EXACT2COLUMNS by3ROWS,6 complete isolated figures only. Each512x512cell contains one ENTIRE complete silhouette including EVERY thin radial tip, full long curved weapon, hair, skirt hem and both boots. Fit whole silhouette inside CENTRAL300x300 to320x320 area, at least96px TRANSPARENT empty margins around every side. Same pixel scale throughout; if weapon raised/extended enlarge empty space rather than crop it. ALL weapon endpoints and radial tips must be fully inside image with generous alpha beyond them. No silhouette overlaps, no body/weapon/rays crossing to neighboring cells. Full body smaller rather than clipped or too big.

Crisp detailed opaque character cutouts, complete gear, no background except alpha0, transparent gaps between parts. ONLY1-2px edge antialias. Gold and orange light are confined INSIDE solid material pixels; weapon must have hard visible edge with NO diffuse outer glow or colored translucent halo. No floor/ground, shadows, aura, bloom, fog, haze, sparks, particles, trails, motion blur, fragments, labels, grids, panels or text. Important: correct original LONG-SKIRT/THIN-GOLD-RAYS/PALE-HAIR identity, original LONG SINUOUS right-hand weapon, true fixed absolute direction, and genuine frame3 connected arm extension in specified heading.
